title: Code review
applies_when: independent review of a finished revision with evidence
does_not_apply_when: review without a revision and evidence bundle
adversarial_probes_warranted: review may request probes; it does not replace them
parallel_guidance: use separate reviewer contexts only when the host provides real isolation; otherwise run standards and spec passes sequentially in one context and record procedural separation plus the limitation; reconcile blocking dispositions before ship
